test_title: PYST 25: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**Option (1) 'YR – DH':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/874395fd2ed41a80c52411beb1ee2ddb940052a0773ebb0fac6cfdd5d94262e0.png] 

**Option (2) 'BU – GK':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e37ccc95b082801fd19a5d579def9cedd4db31cdc233e391c71e089e165bc61.png] 

**Option (3) 'MF – RV':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d8923e96fcc4abf426093deccb3393beda06620785035dbdfdc9e9bd5728ab10.png] 

**Option (4) 'TN – YC':**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51497e59b8eb983e9686723332ab7f641b2e7facfefbc9b32252e4342ed9c426.png] 

In options 1, 2, and 3, the first letter of the cluster pair moves +5 positions forward and the second letter moves -10 positions backward.

**In option 4, the first letter moves +5 positions forward, but the second letter moves -11 positions backward.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4" **.
